ns2:course.label: Extreme Value Theory and Catastrophe Modeling
ns2:course.description: Principles and fundamental techniques of ratemaking for casualty and property insurances; risk classification; coinsurance; estimation of claim liabilities; financial reporting; catastrophe modeling. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for ASRM 469 (formerly MATH 479) and ASRM 569 (formerly MATH 569). Prerequisite: ASRM 401 (formerly Math 408).
